closure_requirements: Implement vn.py-derived execution strategies as versioned AIstock execution policy assets, not Paper v2 ad-hoc code.
Do not deliver or label any simplified, subset, POC, placeholder, mock-only, or skeleton implementation as complete; every in-scope module must satisfy DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001.

Provide a complete vnpy_style core module with source attribution, lifecycle/status/action/order/tick/trade/timer DTOs, and import-boundary separation from FastAPI, DB, MiniQMT, and vn.py runtime engines.

Port Sniper, BestLimit, and TWAP_LITE_MINIQMT core semantics from vnpy_algotrading with derived-from evidence, MIT attribution, preserved state variables/branches, and characterization tests for every mapped behavior in BUG-151 source inventory.

Expose SNIPER_MINIQMT, BEST_LIMIT_MINIQMT, and TWAP_LITE_MINIQMT as validated execution policy assets/capabilities selectable by Paper v2 portfolios/sessions; unsupported modes and missing config must fail fast with structured errors and no fallback.

Add the MiniQMT Paper v2 adapter path that routes selected execution policy assets to broker submit/cancel/status/trade actions while preserving MiniQMT as broker authority and without introducing vn.py EventEngine, AlgoEngine, MainEngine, or gateway runtime.

Persist or surface order/fill/cancel/reject diagnostics with policy id/hash, algo code/version, source mapping, child order lineage, broker ids, raw status/status_msg, cash/position snapshot context where available, and explicit terminal/partial/unfilled states.

Keep QE-ready boundary explicit: core algorithms must be adapter-independent and reusable by future QE shadow/validated execution work; this issue must not mutate QE workspaces, StrategyPackage frozen manifests, model weights, HMM snapshots, or production assets.
Run targeted trading_core/Paper v2 tests plus l0 and validation_module_registry_l0; include git diff --check, import-boundary checks, and a DESIGN-COMPLIANCE-001 matrix before PR readiness.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized and report production gates; do not restart production runtime services, modify .env, write production DB, or apply DDL without explicit approval.
